title: Workplace Health & Safety Policy
description: Outlines the organization's commitment to maintaining a safe and healthy work environment. Covers hazard identification, risk assessment, employee responsibilities, and compliance with occupational health and safety regulations.

title: Prevention of Sexual Harassment (POSH) Policy
description: Defines prohibited conduct, the complaint mechanism, investigation process, and consequences for sexual harassment at the workplace. Ensures compliance with applicable legislation and protects all employees from harassment.

title: Code of Conduct & Ethics Policy
description: Sets the standards of professional behavior, ethical conduct, and integrity expected of all employees. Covers conflicts of interest, confidentiality, use of company resources, and disciplinary procedures.

title: Grievance Redressal Policy
description: Provides employees with a structured mechanism to raise workplace concerns and grievances. Details the escalation path, timelines, and resolution process to ensure fair and prompt redressal.

title: Cybersecurity Awareness Guide
description: Educates employees on identifying phishing attacks, protecting passwords, handling company data securely, and following IT security best practices to protect the organization from cyber threats.
